name: api-breaking-change-detector
description: Cross-references C# Web API controllers/DTOs against their TypeScript/JavaScript consumers (React, Angular, Vue, Svelte, Node.js, or hand-written/auto-generated HTTP clients like Fetch, Axios, NSwag) to catch contract drift in both directions: backend changes that break client applications (renamed/removed JSON keys, new required parameters, status. Use for this specialist task when requested

findings.excerpt: - Search TypeScript/JavaScript files for HTTP client calls (`fetch`, `axios`, Angular `HttpClient`, `ky`, etc.) whose normalized URL pattern matches the control
